coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: Whether an argument component is asserted by the source itself or absent from it, so that unstated components are recorded as fact rather than authored
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Argument Component State

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The source asserts the component in its own words
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Stated

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The source does not assert the component; its absence is the recorded fact
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Unstated

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: How one position attacks another, using the ASPIC+ attack-type trio verbatim; typing a conflict never adjudicates it
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Argument Conflict Type

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: Denies the other position's conclusion
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Rebuts

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: Denies the inference connecting the other position's evidence to its conclusion
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Undercuts

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: Denies the evidence or premises the other position rests on
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Undermines

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The typed connection between two claims in a macro-argument, profiled from argument mining's support and attack relations
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Argument Link Type

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The objection or caveat this claim carries is answered by the target
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Addressed By

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The target claim attacks this claim
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Rebutted By

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: This claim gives support to the target claim
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Supports

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The functional role a component plays in one argument, using Toulmin's (1958) complete six-element layout verbatim — claim, grounds, warrant, backing, qualifier, rebuttal. The set is closed; membership grows only by registered amendment
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Argument Role

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The field-specific support for the warrant itself — the body of fact, statute, experience, or theory on which the warrant rests
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Backing

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The assertion or conclusion the argument establishes
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Claim

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The facts, evidence, or reasons offered in support of the claim
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Grounds

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The modal force with which the claim is advanced
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Qualifier

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The condition of exception under which the claim does not hold
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Rebuttal

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The general licence connecting the grounds to the claim
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Warrant

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: Whether a typed discourse relation is overtly signalled in the source or inferred by the reader, following the PDTB explicit and implicit method in which an implied relation records the connective that would make it explicit
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Discourse Relation Explicitness

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The relation is overtly signalled by connective or construction text quotable from the source
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Explicit

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The relation is unsignalled and inferred; the single inserted connective sentence that would make it explicit is recorded as its basis
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Implied

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The typed sense of a discourse relation between two stated spans of source content, profiled from the PDTB 3.0 sense hierarchy at Level-2 granularity
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Discourse Relation Sense

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: One span gives the reason for, or the result of, the other
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Cause

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: One span creates an expectation the other denies while both stand
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Concession

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: One span holds only under the circumstance the other states
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Condition

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The spans are set against each other on a shared dimension of difference
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Contrast

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: One span gives a specific instance of the generalisation the other states
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Instantiation

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: The structural standing of one content unit relative to a stated purpose, decided by the deletion test from rhetorical structure theory's nuclearity
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Discourse Role

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: Context that orients without carrying the purpose's substance
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Background

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: Central to the purpose; what is kept when one unit must be deleted
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Nucleus

coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.description: Ancillary material serving a nucleus with evidence, elaboration, or explanation
coe:concept/discourse_argumentation_taxo.label: Supportive

description: Classification of discourse and argumentation constructs by relation sense (PDTB Level-2 profile), relation explicitness, Toulmin argument role, component state, ASPIC+ conflict type, rhetorical discourse role, and argument link type
